performance_firewall.quarantined_session_disclosure: Two earlier sessions outside the clean designer accidentally displayed old EXPL-017 metrics before candidate freeze. Those sessions and their candidate suggestions were discarded. The clean designer received no metric values, selected these candidates independently from allowed data semantics, and did not run or inspect performance.

data_contract.cohort_scope: fixed 80-symbol PIT cohort; not a complete dynamic market universe
data_contract.universe_rule: At every decision use canonical universe_at(decision_timestamp); never substitute a current exchange symbol list or a survivor-only universe.
allowed_observations: completed Price V1 daily OHLCV bars
canonical dataset identity, manifest, checksum, and PIT linkage
data_contract.lifecycle_rule: Use Lifecycle V1 as-of the completed decision bar. A confirmed terminal may be liquidated only by its canonical terminal semantics; an unresolved terminal, an internal gap, a missing required entry open, a malformed PIT record, or an otherwise unexplained missing bar is DATA_ERROR_STOP.

common_execution_and_accounting.decision_information_cutoff: UTC close of completed daily bar t, represented as t+1 day minus 1 ms
common_execution_and_accounting.execution: enter or rebalance at the next completed-bar boundary, UTC open of t+1; no decision-bar close-to-open return is earned
common_execution_and_accounting.portfolio: dollar-neutral long-short, equal weight within each leg, 0.50 absolute gross per leg, 1.00 total gross, and 0.00 target net exposure

costs.applies_to: every entry, rebalance delta, lifecycle liquidation, and final close

common_execution_and_accounting.holdout_disclosure: All supported data are Tier 1 exploration data. The 2023 subperiod is a consumed diagnostic, not an untouched holdout or independent confirmation.
common_execution_and_accounting.single_symbol_removal_rule: For each tested primary, identify the symbol with the largest absolute full-window gross PnL contribution using canonical-symbol order as the tie-break, rerun the unchanged primary once with that symbol mechanically excluded at every decision, and require the stress-cost net mean daily return not to become negative. This is a frozen sensitivity diagnostic, not a new candidate or sanity variant.

program_accounting.planned_data_windows_per_tested_candidat: one full supported window plus the three fixed overlapping subperiod diagnostics
program_accounting.planned_variants_per_tested_candidate: primary plus no more than two declared sanity variants
program_accounting.first_pass_stop_rule: Test candidates in order. Stop immediately after the first candidate satisfying every frozen pass condition. If both fail, stop; a third or later candidate is prohibited.
program_accounting.late_program_pass_rule: A pass by candidate order 2 is recorded as LATE_PROGRAM_PASS=YES and requires stronger independent confirmation.
program_accounting.post_run_recording: Record every tested candidate, its primary and declared variants, all viewed windows, and pass/fail counts. Never replace a failed candidate, alter thresholds, or add a variant after result exposure.

screened_candidates.screening_rationale: A short-horizon, volatility-normalized price dislocation is distinct from the closed multi-horizon momentum and broad-volatility sign-switch mechanisms. It needs only completed closes and canonical lifecycle handling.

A pure cohort-relative change in quote-volume share is an attention and demand-migration hypothesis, not a liquidity weight inside a momentum score. It uses the allowed quote-volume field and has a low-complexity rank implementation.
Data-fit and PIT safety are adequate, but its short-horizon reversal premise is too correlated with the selected shock-reversal family for a small one-shot program.
Although data-fit is adequate, conditioning directional price drift risks being interpreted as a narrowed re-test of closed momentum or broad-state mechanisms. It is excluded for mechanism distance.

candidates.economic_rationale: A large one-day price move relative to the instrument's own recent variability can reflect a temporary idiosyncratic liquidity or forced-flow shock. Once the shock is absorbed, the cross-sectional extreme is expected to partially reverse over a short, fixed horizon.
candidates.primary_signal: For each eligible symbol i at completed decision bar t, signal_i = -r_i,t(1 day close-to-close) / sigma_i,t(20 completed close-to-close returns), where sigma is the sample standard deviation. Higher signal denotes a more adverse volatility-normalized shock.
candidates.holding_period: 3 calendar days, next UTC open through the UTC open three calendar days later
candidates.rebalance_schedule: every 3 calendar days, anchored to the first eligible next UTC open on or after 2021-01-25T00:00:00Z
candidates.universe: canonical universe_at(t) filtered only for 20 completed return observations through t, a finite nonzero sigma, a positive execution open at t+1, and lifecycle-valid data
candidates.execution_assumption: rank all eligible members by ascending-average normalized signal with canonical-symbol tie-break; long the highest 20 percent and short the lowest 20 percent, floor one instrument per leg, subject to at least 10 eligible symbols
candidates.missingness_rule: If a required in-window bar, price, volume-independent price input, PIT membership, or execution open is missing or invalid, stop with DATA_ERROR_STOP. Do not shrink the eligible set below 10 or impute. Confirmed Lifecycle V1 terminals follow canonical liquidation semantics only.
candidates.cost_assumption: Apply 15 bps base and 30 bps coarse stress per one-way turnover; all pass conditions use the 30 bps stress series.
candidates.concentration_rule: Equal weights within legs. Each leg is 0.50 gross, total gross is 1.00, target net is 0.00, and no position may exceed 0.50 divided by floor(0.20 times eligible_count) in absolute weight.
candidates.subperiod_rule: Report the full supported window and each of the three fixed program subperiods without retuning. They are Tier 1 diagnostics only; 2023 is never a holdout.

pass_only_if_all_true: Primary full-window stress-cost net mean daily return is strictly positive.
Primary full-window stress-cost annualized Sharpe is at least 0.50.
Primary signal has positive full-window mean cross-sectional rank IC for the fixed 3-day forward-open return and its HAC one-sided p-value is at most 0.05.
Primary stress-cost net return is nonnegative in at least two of the three fixed subperiod diagnostics.
Primary full-window stress-cost maximum drawdown is no worse than -0.35.
No single symbol contributes more than 0.20 of the sum of absolute symbol-level gross PnL contributions over the full window.
The frozen largest-contributor single-symbol-removal rerun does not make full-window stress-cost net mean daily return negative.
Median one-way turnover per rebalance is at most 1.25.
Both declared sanity variants have positive full-window stress-cost net mean daily return and positive mean rank IC in the expected direction.
Lifecycle, universe, PIT linkage, completed-bar timing, and missingness checks all pass without exception.
tier_1_pass_fail_criteria.fail_rule: Any failed condition, data stop, or unavailable required diagnostic is TIER1_FAIL. Ordinary IID t-tests are not used as final evidence.

sanity_variants.change_from_primary: Use 15 completed close-to-close returns for sigma; retain all other primary fields.
Use a 5-calendar-day holding period and 5-calendar-day rebalance schedule; retain all other primary fields.

candidates.economic_rationale: A sustained gain in an instrument's share of activity within the fixed cohort can capture a migration of trader attention and turnover composition that is not encoded by a price-momentum composite. The expected relation is continuation while the activity-share change persists; quote volume is not interpreted as net capital flow.
candidates.signal_interpretation_guardrail: Quote-asset volume is an exchange turnover and attention proxy only. It must never be labeled net inflow, buyer demand, or capital migration.
candidates.primary_signal: For each eligible symbol i at completed decision bar t, signal_i = log(V_i,7 / sum_j V_j,7) - log(V_i,28 / sum_j V_j,28), where V is the sum of completed daily quote-asset volume and j ranges over the same eligible canonical universe at t.
candidates.holding_period: 7 calendar days, next UTC open through the UTC open seven calendar days later
candidates.rebalance_schedule: every 7 calendar days, anchored to the first eligible next UTC open on or after 2021-02-01T00:00:00Z
candidates.universe: canonical universe_at(t) filtered only for 28 completed bars with finite strictly positive quote-asset volume, a positive execution open at t+1, and lifecycle-valid data
candidates.execution_assumption: calculate all cohort shares over one identical eligible universe, use ascending-average normalized ranks with canonical-symbol tie-break, long the highest 20 percent and short the lowest 20 percent, floor one instrument per leg, subject to at least 20 eligible symbols
candidates.missingness_rule: A zero, missing, or invalid required quote-volume observation makes that symbol ineligible before signal calculation. If fewer than 20 symbols remain, or if any required price/PIT/execution/lifecycle input is missing or invalid, stop with DATA_ERROR_STOP; do not impute or substitute a current universe.
candidates.cost_assumption: Apply 15 bps base and 30 bps coarse stress per one-way turnover; all pass conditions use the 30 bps stress series.
candidates.concentration_rule: Equal weights within legs. Each leg is 0.50 gross, total gross is 1.00, target net is 0.00, and no position may exceed 0.50 divided by floor(0.20 times eligible_count) in absolute weight.
candidates.subperiod_rule: Report the full supported window and each of the three fixed program subperiods without retuning. They are Tier 1 diagnostics only; 2023 is never a holdout.

pass_only_if_all_true: Primary full-window stress-cost net mean daily return is strictly positive.
Primary full-window stress-cost annualized Sharpe is at least 0.50.
Primary signal has positive full-window mean cross-sectional rank IC for the fixed 7-day forward-open return and its HAC one-sided p-value is at most 0.05.
Primary stress-cost net return is nonnegative in at least two of the three fixed subperiod diagnostics.
Primary full-window stress-cost maximum drawdown is no worse than -0.35.
No single symbol contributes more than 0.20 of the sum of absolute symbol-level gross PnL contributions over the full window.
The frozen largest-contributor single-symbol-removal rerun does not make full-window stress-cost net mean daily return negative.

tier_1_pass_fail_criteria.fail_rule: Any failed condition, data stop, or unavailable required diagnostic is TIER1_FAIL. Ordinary IID t-tests are not used as final evidence.

sanity_variants.change_from_primary: Use a 5-day short quote-volume window with the 28-day baseline; retain all other primary fields.
Use a 7-day short quote-volume window with a 21-day baseline; retain all other primary fields.

result_interpretation.tier_1_limit: A pass is not a formal run, a confirmed alpha, a Tier 2 admission, a strategy authorization, a dry-run authorization, or live readiness.

freeze_rule: No candidate identity, signal, cohort, timing, costs, thresholds, pass criteria, or sanity variant may change after any sprint result is exposed.
